title: Return of Spitting Image
content: Political satire has a vibrant tradition in Britain, and one of the most dynamic recent programs was a puppet show in the 1990s calledSpitting Image.From the point of view of puppeteering, the characters are caricatures come to life, with a tremendous range of hand, mouth, and eye movements. The scripts and performances are crisp, over-the-top, and rude.Spitting Image has returned withall new episodeslampooning the current crop of politicians, including Boris Johnson, Donald Trump, Mike Pence, Nancy Pelosi, Joe Biden, Prince Charles, and Meghan & Harry.---New Season of Spitting Image,Episode 4
